description: Unit tests for the TestConnectionResponse class, a component involved in connectivity command responses within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.connectivity.modify package.

classes.name: TestConnectionResponseTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for TestConnectionResponse, verifying JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, immutability, and resource path.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Uses EqualsVerifier to test that TestConnectionResponse properly implements equals and hashCode.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that TestConnectionResponse instances are immutable and that related classes are also immutable.

methods.name: createInstanceWithNullConnectionId
methods.description: Verifies that creating a TestConnectionResponse with null ConnectionId throws NullPointerException with expected message.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that a JSON object deserializes into an expected TestConnectionResponse instance.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method produces the expected JSON object.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getResourcePath returns an empty JSON pointer.
